units.source_text: 名人只是等待着工作人员同七段谈判的结果，除此以外别无他事可做。

en.t: The Master merely waited for the result of the staff's negotiations with the seventh-dan player, and apart from that there was nothing else he could do.

units.source_text: 谁也不会把细节告诉名人，名人大概不会知道纠纷闹到对手甚至扬言要放弃这盘棋。

en.t: No one would tell the Master the details, so he probably did not know that the dispute had gone so far that his opponent even threatened to abandon the game.

units.source_text: 可是，徒然地打发日子，也着实叫人着急。

en.t: Yet passing the days in idleness was truly enough to make one impatient.

units.source_text: 名人到川奈饭店去消遣解闷。

en.t: The Master went to the Kawana Hotel to pass the time and relieve his boredom.
I was invited along as well.

units.source_text: 第二天，我又邀了大竹七段。

en.t: The next day, I invited Otake seventh-dan again.
